name: edisonmbli/refactoring-ui
description: A UI design skill that applies Refactoring UI principles, restated in its own words, to improve interfaces, with Tailwind-oriented guidance and design principles for cleaner, more usable layouts. It is an unofficial implementation of principles, not a copy of the book.
install: /plugin install refactoring-ui via marketplace add, per README. README explains marketplace add clones the repo and install loads from the conventional directory, and updates are a renamed git pull.
